title: Audio Analyzer
description: Audio Analyzer is a Java 21 research and engineering platform for reproducible audio experimentation and versioned digital signal processing workflows. It combines a desktop signal workbench with a collaborative browser-based workflow editor, deterministic domain models, recording and replay, evidence export, semantic history, and versioned checkpoints. An optional acoustic-localization module supports microphone-array simulation and research; it is explicitly experimental rather than a validated detector.
